property_summary: For any admissible (identifier, time, ancillaryData), requestPrice invoked by the optimistic asserter must complete without reverting; the mutant's `time + 1` overflows (arithmetic wrapping is forbidden in solidity >=0.8) and reverts when time == type(uint256).max, violating the universal non-reversion rule.
change_summary: Replace the emit argument `time` with `time + 1` so the emitted event reports a different timestamp.
